BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-CompareStructures
BundleInfo.Author: Leonidas Spathis
BundleInfo.Synopsis: Compare secondary and tertiary structure of several proteins at once
BundleInfo.Description: Adds the "compare" command. It superposes two or more protein structures (orthologues, or a mutant and its wild type) with matchmaker and reports, in one step, pairwise RMSD, TM-score, sequence identity and secondary-structure agreement, the per-residue C-alpha deviation (also set as a residue attribute and coloured on the structures), the substitutions between each structure and the reference, and optional report files.

Classifiers.ChimeraXClassifier: ChimeraX :: Command :: compare :: Structure Comparison :: Compare secondary and tertiary structure of two or more proteins
